verdict.rationale: Plausible gives you a single fixed dashboard that you can share publicly or with specific people via links, embed on any page, and narrow with filters and segments. There is no evidence that you can save individual insights or charts and compose them into custom dashboards; consolidated view only rolls multiple sites into one dashboard. Missing for 10: saved insights/reports as reusable objects, composing custom multi-widget dashboards, team-specific dashboard curation.
